scripts.text:
[Pet Trader]
Making a living through business ain't easy.
I get real bad motion sickness, yet today I got caught up in a storm on my way here.
scripts.translation:
[宠物商人]
做生意可真不容易。
我晕车晕得厉害，结果今天来这里的路上还赶上了暴风雨。

scripts.text:
[Pet Trader]
It was such a horrible experience. Thanks to that, I don't feel so good. Ughh...
scripts.translation:
[宠物商人]
真是糟糕透了。因为这件事，我现在感觉很不舒服。唉...

scripts.text:
[Pet Trader]
Anyway, did you come here looking for a Cute Pet?
You've brought a ticket with you, right?
scripts.translation:
[宠物商人]
总之，你是来找可爱的宠物的吗？
你身上带着兑换券吧？

scripts.text:
[Pet Trader]
I don't think you've got the stuff I want.
scripts.translation:
[宠物商人]
我觉得你没有我想要的东西。

scripts.text:
[Pet Trader]
Which ticket do you want to exchange?
scripts.translation:
[宠物商人]
你想兑换哪张券？

scripts.text:
[Pet Trader]
Great!
^0000FF{0}^000000
Are you sure you want this pet?
scripts.translation:
[宠物商人]
太好了！
^0000FF{0}^000000
你确定要这只宠物吗？

scripts.text:
You're carrying too much stuff!
Come back when you've made some space.
scripts.translation:
你携带的物品太多了！
腾出一些空间后再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Pet Trader]
So you want hear about the land across the sea, but I ain't feeling so well today.
scripts.translation:
[宠物商人]
你想听关于海那边的土地的故事，但我今天身体不太舒服。
